documentRulesUsedByRepair: refresh_interval is measured in seconds and gates ordinary configuration checks.
A call before that interval elapses returns immediately without contacting the store.
A watched sentinel change is the publication signal for ordinary-setting reload.
secret_refresh_interval is an independently configured interval in seconds.
When refresh() is called and the secret interval has elapsed, the provider can retrieve fresh secret values.
Secret refresh does not require the App Configuration reference or sentinel to change.
The versionless reference supports adoption of a newly stored enabled secret version.
